## What changes for someone using the app

<!-- One or two sentences, plain words. -->

## Why

<!-- The problem it solves. Link the issue: "Closes #123". -->

## How I tested it

- [ ] `node frontend/tests/run.mjs` passes (or say which groups you ran and why)
- [ ] I added or changed a test that fails without this change
- [ ] I tried it in the app with made-up links

## Screenshots

<!-- For anything you can see: before and after, dark and light theme, and phone width if layout changed. Made-up links only. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] One focused change, with no unrelated reformatting
- [ ] No real personal data, keys, sessions or databases anywhere (code, tests, screenshots, logs)
- [ ] No new network requests, telemetry or accounts, or they're agreed in an issue and listed under *Network activity* in the README
- [ ] No new dependencies, or they're agreed in an issue and added to THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md
- [ ] New files are listed in PUBLIC_SOURCE_MANIFEST.md
- [ ] If I used AI tools, I've read, understood and run everything I'm submitting (tools used: )
